scope: public reviewer materials that do not broaden DotMatch's validated scientific scope

items.title: Bioinformatics evaluation packet
items.done_when: Reviewers can see package channels, validated assay scope, minimum commands, output files, workflow status, and public wording rules.

items.title: External review packet
items.done_when: Workflow maintainers, PIs, and technical reviewers have one checklist for install proof, output contracts, validated scope, and known blockers.

items.title: Integration target tracker
items.done_when: nf-core, MultiQC, Galaxy/IUC, Snakemake, and bio.tools targets have machine-readable status, source assets, external targets, and next actions.

items.title: bio.tools registry draft
items.done_when: Registry metadata is ready to review without implying accepted registry status.

items.title: DotMatch evaluation protocol
items.done_when: Reviewers can assess workflow fit, outputs, limitations, and public-use permission without exposing sensitive data.

items.title: Public use record template
items.done_when: Approved public use records use consistent fields and scope notes.

items.title: Workflow integration issue template
items.done_when: External integration requests ask for workflow manager, source assets, expected outputs, fixtures, and validated scope.

items.title: Evaluation feedback issue template
items.done_when: Evaluation feedback can be submitted with install path, assay context, outputs inspected, blockers, and public-use permission.

items.title: Pull request language checklist
items.done_when: Public wording changes require validated-scope, workflow-status, and unsupported-language checks.

items.title: Reviewer readiness gate
items.done_when: `make reviewer-readiness-ready` verifies the assets, statuses, and public-language guardrails.
